Welfare check and walkthrough of Wheirko Lane, Commercial Bay, all clear.

Response message from Will via the community thread regarding a public drinker around their area.

The guard at Walker & Hall advised the individual left immediately before our arrival.
Check-in at corner of Shortland Street and Queen Street, all clear.
Check-in at Queens Arcade, all clear. Ending Echo Route and heading into lunch break.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Bodycam, 5 x Keys.

Arrived at corner of Durham Street East and Queen Street; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear. Standing by for nearby response calls and security presence for surrounding businesses and the public.
Leaving standby; no issues or response calls received.
Vulcan Lane check-in, all clear; welfare checks on stores along Queen Street between Durham Street East and Vulcan Lane, all clear — nothing to report from any store.
Pocket Park check-in, all clear; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear.
Imperial Lane check-in, all clear; welfare checks on stores within the area, all clear. Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants.
On arrival at TK Square, heard a male yelling from afar; Graff security pointed out the direction the male POI went — heading up Queen Street.
Gained visual on the male POI; shadowing him from a distance in case he goes off again.
Lost visual of the POI; standing by outside Kathmandu Queen Street.
TK Square; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear. Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants.

While on standby at TK Square, noticed Police running into McDonald's Britomart. Attended: a male had got into a fight with another customer inside, but the other party had already left the premises. No response call was received and nothing was reported during our welfare check. Standing by, gathering information and footage.
Information received that the male had also spat on the people he fought with. (Footage on file.) Continuing standby.
Law enforcement left the area along with the male individual; commencing patrols.
High Street check-in; walking through with welfare checks on stores.
Chancery Square / Freyberg Square; welfare checks on stores all clear. Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any issues.
Corner of High Street and Victoria Street East check-in, all clear; walking through Lorne Street with welfare checks.
Lorne Street fountain; welfare checks complete, no issues reported. Standing by for security presence.
No issues or response calls while on standby; departing the area.
Corner of Rutland and Queen Street check-in, all clear; heading back to HQ for floor checks.
Floor checks completed; gearing up for patrols.
Arrived at Elliott Stables; standing by.
Top of Victoria Street West; welfare checks on stores within the area and along Victoria Street West, all clear. Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for issues or vagrants.
St Patricks Square; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear.
St Patricks Square sweep complete, no issues.
TK Square check-in; welfare check on McDonald's Britomart, all clear. Heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone.
At HQ charging the Ops Phone, on 1% (percentage displayed on the kitchen camera).
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street about a male vagrant who entered the store and made a mess with their rubbish bins; assistance requested to move him along.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street; the male was outside the store. Approached him, advised him not to return, and issued a verbal trespass — he was compliant. Standing by while he remained in the area.
Bottom of Wyndham Street; welfare check on QF Tavern and Ibis Budget Hotel, all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading back to HQ to let boss AJ up into the office.
At HQ standing by for handover.
Afternoon Shift concluded. Auror reports have been processed.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street and 77 Convenience Store completed, all clear.
Full sweep of Aotea Square conducted. Observed a couple and a single male involved in a loud verbal argument; officers maintained a visible security presence to monitor the situation.
Call received from McDonald's Britomart regarding an intoxicated male bringing alcohol into the restaurant and disturbing customers; officers attended (arrival logged at 01:00 in the raw record).
A customer had contacted Police, who arrested the individual upon arrival. Due to the number of customers present, officers remained at the restaurant to maintain a visible security presence.
Commercial Bay and the Bus Interchange checked, all clear.
Welfare check on the ASG guard at Rosie's completed, all clear.
St Patrick's Cathedral and surrounding areas checked, all clear.
77 Convenience Store on Victoria Street checked; no incidents reported. Several individuals were present around the store, so officers maintained a visible security presence.
Full sweep of Queen Street completed, all clear; officers remained available for calls.
Welfare check at Jo & Joe completed, all clear; Wilson Carpark on Gore Street also checked with no issues.
Welfare check at Red Radisson completed, all clear.
Auckland Library and surrounding areas checked, all clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street: a female individual was found sleeping inside the restaurant. Officers requested that she leave, and she complied. No further issues.
Proceeding to Headquarters as the Ops Phone battery had dropped to 10%.
Arrived at Headquarters; phone placed on charge, officers available for calls.
Officers on break at Headquarters while the Ops Phone continued charging (battery at 14%).

flags: SENSITIVE: 16:39 fight between customers inside McDonald's Britomart; the male later spat on the other party (footage on file); Police handled the incident.
TIME ANOMALY: Night 01:07 call entry notes officers 'arrived at 01:00'; raw timestamps inconsistent.
QA: Night log ends at 05:06 with no handover entry recorded.
QA: 09:26/09:32 Durham Street alleyway labels are swapped relative to other days this week (East/West lists interchanged in the raw log); rendered as written.
